messages:
olivia: MediAssist POC (Android) hit during demo: SSE stream sometimes produces 'Unexpected end of JSON input' and client disconnects after ~10-20s. Can eng triage? cc @sam @nina

sam: Do they route through a gateway/CDN? Need raw SSE chunks + client log.

olivia: Yes — their Apigee in front. Client snippet:
```
E/Stream: JSON.parse error: Unexpected end of JSON input
E/Stream: last_chunk='\{"note\":\"Refill due on'
```
Raw concatenated SSE bytes they captured:
```
data: {"type":"note","payload":{"pt":55,"note":"Refill due on

data:  medication"}}}\n\n```

nina: Looks like the payload is split across chunk boundaries so the JSON is incomplete when parsed. Common causes: gateway buffering, gzip/recompress, or idle timeouts closing/reshaping chunks. Ask them to enable streaming mode and disable response buffering for the route.

sam: Also recommend server heartbeats: emit a comment line every 7s like `: hb\n\n` so Apigee idle timeout < 7s won't kill it. Ensure `Content-Type: text/event-stream`, `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`, and flush after each event. If Apigee keeps re-chunking, consider NDJSON temporarily.

olivia: They report gateway idle timeout = 18s. We'll ask for streaming flag + disable buffering. Can Redwood insert a short-lived heartbeat on our demo tenant?

nina: We can push a quick demo patch to emit heartbeats for this tenant. Ops-bot, file a POC ticket.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: POC-6123 created and assigned to eng-platform (tag: sse-heartbeat)

olivia: Thanks — joining their call now to walk through Apigee toggles and we'll push the patch. Will update after the call. :thumbsup:
